/*
 * RISC-V RVV optimized SBR DSP
 *
 * This file is a minimal, buildable stub for RVV.
 * Replace the scalar loop with a true RVV implementation.
 */

#include "libavutil/riscv/asm.S"

#if HAVE_RVV

/*
 * void ff_sbr_neg_odd_64_rvv(float *x);
 * Negate odd-indexed elements in a 128-float buffer.
 */
func ff_sbr_neg_odd_64_rvv
    /* a0 = float *x */
    /* Minimal correct scalar implementation (TODO: RVV vectorize). */
    li      t0, 64
1:
    lw      t1, 4(a0)
    neg     t1, t1
    sw      t1, 4(a0)
    addi    a0, a0, 8
    addi    t0, t0, -1
    bnez    t0, 1b
    ret
endfunc ff_sbr_neg_odd_64_rvv

#endif /* HAVE_RVV */

--- a/libavcodec/riscv/sbrdsp_init.c
+++ b/libavcodec/riscv/sbrdsp_init.c
@@ -1,3 +1,39 @@
+/*
+ * RISC-V SBR DSP init
+ *
+ * Minimal RVV hook for ff_sbr_neg_odd_64.
+ */
+
+#include "config.h"
+
+#include "libavcodec/sbrdsp.h"
+
+void ff_sbrdsp_init_riscv(SBRDSPContext *s)
+{
+    /* TODO: if this file already has other init logic, merge accordingly. */
+#if HAVE_RVV
+    void ff_sbr_neg_odd_64_rvv(float *x);
+    s->neg_odd_64 = ff_sbr_neg_odd_64_rvv;
+#endif
+}

--- a/libavcodec/riscv/Makefile
+++ b/libavcodec/riscv/Makefile
@@ -1,3 +1,8 @@
+OBJS-$(CONFIG_SBRDSP)                 += riscv/sbrdsp_init.o
+
+RVV-OBJS-$(CONFIG_SBRDSP)             += riscv/sbrdsp_rvv.o
+
+# TODO: If this Makefile already defines RVV-OBJS / OBJS patterns, integrate these lines.
